name: Ariglad
long_description:
Founded in Vancouver, British Columbia, Ariglad The first AI platform that integrates with support channels and release notes to auto-maintain your knowledge base. Ariglad suggests new articles, updates existing ones, detects duplicates, and merges them. Basically, it puts your knowledge base maintenance on auto-pilot.

This is led by Co-Founders Sophie and Ali. They are both completely obsessed with this problem and their customers, who have partnered with Ariglad to become immensely more efficient.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Worked in a few different industries before falling for tech (such as the US Department of State, Big Pharma, etc.) and worked as a CSM in cybersecurity, primarily with Fortune 1000 CIOs.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: CTO and co-founder who built AI-powered knowledge management and HR/IT help desk products from zero to enterprise adoption. Expertise in LLM pipelines, enterprise integrations, and security & compliance, including SOC 2 and GDPR. Previously built products across healthcare technology, computer vision, and enterprise HR case management.

news.title: Ariglad raises $1.3 million to help HR teams communicate better, fulfill ticket systems | BetaKit
